title: Kasp's Kobblemon
description: Welcome to my Cobblemon modpack—a cozy-but-adventurous take on Minecraft where classic exploration meets Pokémon-style discovery.
body:
Welcome to my Cobblemon modpack—a cozy-but-adventurous take on Minecraft where classic exploration meets Pokémon-style discovery. This pack is built around smooth progression, immersive biomes, and a balanced survival experience that rewards curiosity as much as strategy. Whether you’re hunting rare Pokémon across diverse landscapes, building a base that actually feels alive, or teaming up with friends for battles and exploration, everything here is tuned to feel fun, intuitive, and just a little bit magical. If you like discovering things at your own pace, getting attached to your team, and letting stories emerge naturally, this pack’s got your name on it. This modpack is recommended to be paired with Kasp's server.

More info at twitch.tv/kaspsss (ask me there)
